mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chapters WHERE id=#{chapter} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter_quizzes(chapter_id,book_id,source_hash,questions_json,status,request_id,lease_expires_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{chapterId},#{bookId},#{sourceHash},NULL,'generating',#{requestId},#{leaseExpiresAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE book_id=#{bookId},source_hash=#{sourceHash},questions_json=NULL,status='generating',request_id=#{requestId},lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt},updated_at=#{updatedAt}
mapper.update: UPDATE chapter_quizzes SET status='ready',questions_json=#{questions},lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE chapter_id=#{chapter} AND request_id=#{request} AND status='generating'
UPDATE chapter_quizzes SET status='failed',lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE chapter_id=#{chapter} AND request_id=#{request} AND status='generating'
